profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorganChase | Backend Engineering | Java, Python & Spring Boot | APIs, Microservices & Payment Platforms
profile.summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience developing and supporting backend applications, microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-based platforms. Currently working at JPMorganChase within the Unified Payment Gateway organization, contributing to payment-processing capabilities for merchants and enterprise clients.
 
My experience includes supporting complete payment lifecycles involving authorization, capture, verification, refunds, and voids. I also have experience with Java, Python, Spring Boot, microservices, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud migration, automated testing, and production support.
 
I enjoy solving complex backend problems, improving application reliability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to build secure, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Contribute to the design, development and support of the Unified Payment Gateway (UPG), a business-critical platform responsible for processing merchant and client payment transactions. 
•  Develop and maintain backend services and APIs supporting the complete payment transaction lifecycle, including authorization, capture, verification, refunds and voids. 
• Implement reliable payment-processing workflows that validate transaction requests, coordinate processing, and return consistent responses to merchants and client applications. 
• Troubleshoot defects and production issues across distributed payment flows, perform root-cause analysis and collaborate with partner teams to improve platform reliability. 
• Participate in system design discussions, code reviews, automated testing, release readiness and production-support activities. 
• Collaborate with product owners, architects, quality engineers and other development teams to deliver secure and scalable payment capabilities. 
• Contribute to continuous improvements in application performance, code quality, operational stability and the overall merchant payment experience.

projects.title: ATM Machine Simulation
projects.description:
Role: Full-Stack Developer
Technologies: Java, JavaScript, ReactJS, MySQL, REST APIs

Developed a fully functional ATM Machine Simulation application to mimic real-world banking operations, providing a user-friendly experience for deposits, withdrawals, balance inquiries, and transaction histories. This project showcases the integration of backend and frontend technologies to simulate ATM functionalities in a responsive, secure environment. Key features include:

* User Authentication: Implemented secure login and session management to protect user data and enable personalized access to account details.
* Account Transactions: Developed core functionalities for depositing and withdrawing funds, updating balances in real-time, and managing overdraft limits.
* Transaction History: Designed an interactive history feature to display detailed records of past transactions, allowing users to monitor account activity.
* Database Integration: Utilized MySQL to store user account information and transaction data, ensuring accuracy and quick access to records.
* Frontend-Backend Communication: Connected the ReactJS front end with Java-based backend REST APIs, enabling seamless data exchange and dynamic updates across the application.

This project demonstrates proficiency in Java, RESTful API development, front-end design with ReactJS, and backend database management with MySQL, delivering a realistic and interactive banking experience.

projects.title: Library POS System
projects.description:
Role: Software Developer
Technologies: C++, OOP principles, File I/O, Data Structures

Developed a Library POS (Point of Sale) System in C++ to streamline library management and improve efficiency in handling book inventories, member records, and transaction processing. The system provides a user-friendly interface, enabling library staff to add, search, and update books, manage member accounts, and track checkouts and returns. Key features include:

* Inventory Management: Enabled efficient book tracking, including adding new books, updating existing entries, and categorizing by genre, author, and publication year.
* Member Management: Built a robust module for registering members, tracking borrowing history, and issuing fines for overdue returns.
* Transaction Handling: Automated the checkout and return processes, updating inventory in real-time to minimize human errors.
* Data Persistence: Used file I/O for data storage, ensuring all records were saved and easily retrievable on program restart.

This project demonstrates proficiency in C++ programming, particularly in object-oriented design, file handling, and data management, while building a practical solution for library operations.
